expected_metrics.recent_visual_recall_accuracy: = 100% on fixture set (harness mechanism gate — in-window resolvable, out-of-window not)

description: Tests the 30-60s ring buffer window bound. Three sub-cases: (1) in-window referent (frame at t=5000ms, query at t=40000ms, window=60000ms) — resolvable; (2) out-of-window referent (frame at t=0ms, query at t=65000ms, window=60000ms) — NOT resolvable; (3) edge: frame at t=5000ms, query at t=64000ms (still in window) — resolvable. The ring buffer uses event timestamp_mono_ms, not wall-clock time. VisionSidecar window_ms=60000.

fixture_conventions.deictic_p: All frames are deictic (>= 0.8) — 'what did I just pick up?'
fixture_conventions.scene_change_score: Scripted. Not the focus of this fixture.
fixture_conventions.grounding_result: 'keys' for in-window resolvable frames; null for out-of-window (not resolvable).
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: 0.89 for resolvable frames; null for out-of-window.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'in_window', 'out_of_window', or 'edge_in_window'. Consumers (task 11) partition by this field.
fixture_conventions.in_window_design: frame-000 at t=5000ms ingested into ring buffer. Query frame at t=40000ms. 40000-5000=35000ms < window_ms=60000ms => in-window, resolvable. deictic_grounding event emitted with caused_by referencing frame-000.
fixture_conventions.out_of_window_design: frame-200 at t=0ms ingested. Query frame at t=65000ms. 65000-0=65000ms > window_ms=60000ms => evicted, NOT resolvable. No deictic_grounding event emitted (or emitted with frame_event_id=null).
fixture_conventions.edge_in_window_design: frame-300 at t=5000ms ingested. Query frame at t=64000ms. 64000-5000=59000ms < window_ms=60000ms => still in-window, resolvable.
fixture_conventions.timestamp_mono_ms_drives_eviction: VisionSidecar evicts frames whose timestamp_mono_ms is more than window_ms behind the latest ingested frame's timestamp_mono_ms. This makes eviction deterministic and testable with fixture-injected timestamps.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels.

signal_trace.notes: IN-WINDOW REFERENT: ingested at t=5000ms; query at t=40000ms; 35000ms < 60000ms window => resolvable
IN-WINDOW GATE FRAME: t=40000ms; referent frame-000 at t=5000ms is within 60s window; grounding must resolve to 'keys' with caused_by referencing frame-000
OUT-OF-WINDOW REFERENT: ingested at t=0ms; query at t=65000ms; 65000ms > 60000ms window => evicted, NOT resolvable
OUT-OF-WINDOW GATE FRAME: t=65000ms; frame-200 at t=0ms is 65000ms ago > 60000ms window; evicted; grounding must return not-resolvable (frame_event_id=null)
EDGE REFERENT: ingested at t=5000ms; query at t=64000ms; 59000ms < 60000ms => still in window
EDGE GATE FRAME: t=64000ms; 64000-5000=59000ms < 60000ms => frame-300 still in buffer; grounding resolves to 'keys'

baseline_decisions.notes: 65000ms > window; evicted; NOT resolvable; negative path proves window bound is real
59000ms < window; still resolvable at the edge
